education.chapter_complete: Chapter ended: {practiced} practiced, {read} read, {skipped} skipped. Skipped exercises are still available to practice again.

accessibility.completion: Reference only; labels and icons remain readable.
accessibility.description: Choose graphics and color assistance in settings. Labels, borders, badges and relationships supplement territory colors. Adjust quality for your device; display changes do not change deterministic AI decisions.
accessibility.exercise: Try a color assistance theme and inspect adjacent countries at two zoom levels.
accessibility.title: Graphics, labels and color accessibility

account.completion: Reference only; the service confirms signed-in status.
account.description: Use the account menu and supported sign-in providers. Account services are external to this repository and require network access. Single-player training does not require new account API development.
account.exercise: Inspect sign-in and account settings without sharing tokens.
account.title: Account and sign-in

ai.completion: Reference only; player information displays the configured AI profile.
ai.description: Tribes and nations are separate controllers. Difficulty can include resource advantages; inspect the displayed settings before a match. Strategic personality and decision strength are separate from country identity and color.
ai.exercise: Compare difficulty, AI count and disclosed resource rules.
ai.prerequisites: AI settings in a supported single-player or custom lobby.
ai.title: AI controllers and difficulty

alliance.completion: An active alliance is practical evidence; rejection does not count as success.
alliance.description: Request an alliance; the recipient may accept or reject. Respond to incoming requests, extend before expiry or break an alliance. Betrayal applies the existing traitor penalty and can damage diplomacy.
alliance.exercise: Request an alliance and wait for acceptance; if refused, choose another partner or retry later.
alliance.prerequisites: Alliances enabled and a living eligible partner.
alliance.title: Alliance request, rejection, extension and betrayal

attack.completion: Owned land increases; opponent conquest requires an actual conquest event.
attack.description: Attack adjacent wilderness or an enemy border. Compare troops, terrain and defenses. Attacks consume committed troops; an ongoing attack or gold income does not prove you captured land.
attack.exercise: Gain land, then conquer a nearby opponent while retaining defenders.
attack.prerequisites: Spawn phase ended, reachable border and enough troops.
attack.title: Expansion and land conquest

attack_ratio.completion: The guide observes a real ratio change.
attack_ratio.description: The ratio determines the troops committed to an attack. A high ratio leaves fewer defenders. Use the slider or your currently assigned ratio keys; expected risk is approximate.
attack_ratio.exercise: Adjust the attack ratio and inspect the remaining troop reserve.
attack_ratio.title: Attack ratio and troop commitment

audio.completion: Reference only; the chosen settings persist.
audio.description: Adjust master, music, effects, alerts, ambience and interface levels. Background or focus settings govern when sounds play. Choose useful alerts without covering the map with message panels.
audio.exercise: Change a category volume and inspect focus/mute controls.
audio.title: Audio and notification controls

camera.completion: Reference only; camera movements are not scored by the practical course.
camera.description: Pan, zoom, center on your country, switch map view and toggle coordinates. Ownership colors and borders show who controls land; zoom out to inspect other fronts.
camera.exercise: Move the camera, zoom and find your territory. Use current settings for keyboard controls.
camera.title: Map movement, zoom and territory

city.completion: An active completed city belongs to you.
city.description: Build cities on legal owned land to increase troop capacity. The active build menu supplies the current cost and placement restrictions. A construction site is not a completed city.
city.exercise: Place a city and wait for construction to finish.
city.prerequisites: Cities enabled, enough gold and legal owned tile.
city.title: City

clan.completion: Reference only; the service confirms membership and tag.
clan.description: The clan menu manages available clan actions through the existing service. Tags identify affiliation; a lobby can hide tags. Clan membership does not override the match's team and alliance rules.
clan.exercise: Inspect your clan and the lobby's tag display setting.
clan.prerequisites: Account, connectivity and applicable clan permissions.
clan.title: Clans and clan tags

communication.completion: Reference only; the message is displayed to the allowed recipient.
communication.description: Use contextual quick chat or send emoji through the player menu. Collapse or close chat when it covers the battlefield. Messages do not change combat orders.
communication.exercise: Open the message menu, choose a phrase or emoji, and close it.
communication.prerequisites: Communication controls and an allowed recipient.
communication.title: Quick chat and emoji

cosmetics.completion: Reference only; the confirmed owned selection is displayed.
cosmetics.description: Use inventory and shop controls for supported appearances. Some items require an account, entitlement or purchase through the existing service. Free accessibility labels and borders remain useful alongside cosmetics.
cosmetics.exercise: Preview an appearance and inspect its availability before choosing it.
cosmetics.prerequisites: Existing inventory/shop service and applicable account entitlement.
cosmetics.title: Inventory, appearance and shop

defense.completion: An active completed defense post belongs to you.
defense.description: Defense posts strengthen nearby defense. Check the placement preview and frontier; overlapping posts can waste gold compared with covering an exposed border.
defense.exercise: Complete a defense post near an important frontier.
defense.prerequisites: Defense posts enabled and an affordable legal site.
defense.title: Defense post

delete.completion: Reference only; cancellation leaves the unit, deletion removes it.
delete.description: The unit menu exposes deletion for eligible owned units. Inspect the confirmation and any refund shown; removal does not promise a full refund and may remove a useful defense or route.
delete.exercise: Inspect the removal control before confirming or cancelling.
delete.prerequisites: An owned unit with a deletion control.
delete.title: Delete a unit or cancel construction

doomsday.completion: Reference only; observe the rule's actual game-state effects.
doomsday.description: Special public rules can add a doomsday clock or overtime pressure. Inspect the displayed countdown and rule details; do not assume the normal conquest pacing or resource behavior.
doomsday.exercise: Read the active rule and countdown before committing troops.
doomsday.prerequisites: A match with the special rule enabled.
doomsday.title: Doomsday clock and overtime

embargo.completion: Reference only; observe the embargo status and trade effect.
embargo.description: Start or stop trade restrictions for a country or all countries using the available controls. Embargoes affect eligible trade, so political pressure can also reduce your income.
embargo.exercise: Inspect the trade status and the start/stop restriction controls.
embargo.prerequisites: An eligible target and trade controls.
embargo.title: Embargo and embargo all

factory.completion: Factory completion is practiced; train behavior is explained separately.
factory.description: Factories create train stations and connect eligible nearby cities, ports and factories. Trains and rails are generated by the economy; you do not build a train directly. Connections must satisfy route rules.
factory.exercise: Finish a factory, then inspect its automatically generated connections.
factory.prerequisites: Factories enabled, affordable land site and eligible nearby structures for connections.
factory.title: Factory, trains and connected economy

fronts.completion: Reference only; judge territorial change and troop losses.
fronts.description: Incoming attacks reduce safety elsewhere. Preserve a troop reserve, reinforce a valuable border and counterattack only when the commitment is affordable. Concentrating force can outperform many small attacks.
fronts.exercise: Inspect every incoming front before choosing one response.
fronts.title: Counterattacks and several fronts

identity.completion: Reference only; compare the visible identity labels.
identity.description: Basic tribes remain gray. Names, flags, AI badges and player information distinguish controllers. Team and alliance markings carry relationship information; color alone is insufficient.
identity.exercise: Inspect a human, tribe and nation, then check their team or alliance.
identity.prerequisites: Player labels or player information available.
identity.title: Humans, tribes, nations and teams

keybindings.completion: Reference only; one key input should invoke the intended action once.
keybindings.description: Controls and button labels share the effective bindings. Nonconflicting custom keys are preserved. Legacy bindings that conflict with required modern controls are backed up with a visible migration notice. Rebind or reset them in Settings.
keybindings.exercise: Rebind an action and verify the guide and hotbar show the effective key.
keybindings.title: Keyboard shortcuts and rebinding

lobby.completion: Reference only; server-confirmed lobby settings govern the match.
lobby.description: Create a custom room, share its invite and configure settings before start. The host controls the start timer and eligible player removal. Anonymized names and clan-tag rules affect display. Public listing may require an account entitlement.
lobby.exercise: Review the lobby settings and player list before starting.
lobby.prerequisites: Network connectivity; host controls require ownership of the room.
lobby.title: Create, invite, configure and host a room

mobile.completion: Reference only; cancellation must leave resources and units unchanged.
mobile.description: Drag to pan, pinch to zoom and tap territory for contextual actions. Preview action cost and placement before committing; close or cancel to back out. Inspect available quickbar layout and handedness options in settings.
mobile.exercise: Preview a legal build and cancel before confirming another action.
mobile.prerequisites: A touch device or touch-enabled browser.
mobile.title: Touch controls and quickbar

modern.completion: Reference only; initial ownership and the actual scenario result must be verified in play.
modern.description: Choose a supported country before starting. Initial owned tiles represent the scenario's processed borders; capitals and starting economy are game scenario data. Inspect coverage and map resolution rather than assuming every small country is represented.
modern.exercise: Search or select a country, inspect its neighbors, start on its territory and conquer another country.
modern.prerequisites: Modern scenario selected and a supported country.
modern.title: Modern world: country selection and conquest

modern_ai.completion: The core roster contains fixed AI levels. Lobby fill is validated by server/core tests; reading this lesson does not pretend to verify an online room.
modern_ai.description: AI levels are independent seeded low/medium/high decisions with default 1:1:1 weights. Personality and climate adaptation are separate. Invitation AI fills empty participant slots at the start; unselected world factions have their own AI without duplicate control.
modern_ai.exercise: Inspect actual AI level labels and common population, then configure participant slots and autofill before inviting another human.
modern_ai.prerequisites: Modern v2 AI game or private invitation room. Online room creation uses the existing lobby service.
modern_ai.title: Individual AI levels and invitation-slot fill

modern_air.completion: A new core base, outbound/returning/rearming transitions and actual aircraft casualties are required.
modern_air.description: Fighters contest airspace and intercept. Strike aircraft damage ground troops, facilities and ports without capturing land. Sorties use a base, radius, personnel, upkeep, real flight positions, return and resupply cooldown. SAM aircraft interception has its own cost and reload.
modern_air.exercise: Build another base, send a squadron on patrol or strike, watch its return and rearm, then observe an actual interception casualty.
modern_air.prerequisites: An operating airbase and owned aircraft. Interception exercise also needs enabled SAM or enemy fighters.
modern_air.title: Airbases, sorties and interception

modern_climate.completion: Both preview efficiencies plus actual ground casualties are checked; training requires its completed core counter.
modern_climate.description: Historical regional climate is separate from terrain and temporary weather. Army adaptation applies at the engagement tile, with mild climates spared harsh penalties. Capture does not instantly train troops. Training costs time and gold and has two adaptation slots.
modern_climate.exercise: Compare actual-route climate previews on adapted and harsh unadapted battle locations, fight, then complete a new adaptation training.
modern_climate.prerequisites: Modern v2, an army group and enough gold. The overlay is an explanation of climate, not current weather.
modern_climate.title: Regional climate and adaptation training

modern_commands.completion: Actual camera/selection/valid preview, acknowledged queue/movement/stop, paid base completion and paid unit production are checked.
modern_commands.description: Branch selection does not launch units. Click, box or add-select units, point to preview, then right-click to move or attack. Shift queues; Stop halts a real order; Esc cancels preview or selection.
modern_commands.exercise: Practice camera, branches, selection, arrows, immediate orders, queue and stop. Complete army-base construction, training and naval-base ship movement.
modern_commands.prerequisites: Independent Regions and an owned unit. All effective keys appear in Controls; mobile uses branch and target buttons.
modern_commands.title: Q/W/E and map commands

modern_nuclear.completion: A new acknowledged launch responsibility record and active income penalty must exist; merely opening the launch menu does not complete it.
modern_nuclear.description: Each launch applies a timed penalty to the firing faction even if intercepted or its target disappears. MIRV is one launch, not one penalty per warhead. Repeated penalties cap income and replenishment losses and expire by game tick. Victim damage is separate.
modern_nuclear.exercise: Inspect the launch warning, fire once, observe victim damage and your own economic penalty, then compare conventional aircraft or army.
modern_nuclear.prerequisites: Use the nuclear training chapter with enabled weapons, a ready owned silo and enough gold.
modern_nuclear.title: Nuclear cost and lasting responsibility

modern_population.completion: Equal initial ledgers are checked against N0. The loss exercise requires actual army casualties.
modern_population.description: Every human and AI starts with the same game population N0 and common budget. Civilian, available, army, navy and air personnel sum to living population. Losses and transfers conserve people; actual national population is unused.
modern_population.exercise: Open the ledger, produce a squadron, engage an opponent and inspect casualties and replenishment.
modern_population.prerequisites: Modern v2 and an owned force. Aircraft need available personnel, gold and capacity.
modern_population.title: Equal population and military accounting

modern_ports.completion: Completion requires real capture, finished development, increased income, an enemy-port blockade, and observing then ending an own-port blockade with recovered income.
modern_ports.description: Named historical port locations have one unique portId. Initially closed, they earn a bounded bonus only for their current owner after paid development. Damage, blockade and connection change operation. General ports keep ordinary trade without copying the unique bonus.
modern_ports.exercise: Capture a major port, repair damage when needed, pay for development and observe increased income. Blockade an enemy port and respond to an enemy blockade of your own.
modern_ports.prerequisites: Own or capture a designated major port. Development needs gold and time; blockade needs an owned nearby fleet.
modern_ports.title: Capture, develop and blockade major ports

modern_regions.completion: Core state contains unique faction and controller IDs; no region has two rulers.
modern_regions.description: Countries exceeding 1.2M km² split along administrative boundaries, with a 0.8–1.2M km² goal. Every region has its own controller, center and adaptation; area exceptions retain reasons. Tiles are not km².
modern_regions.exercise: Choose a Russian, Chinese or Indian region and inspect its area, exception and administrative center before starting.
modern_regions.prerequisites: Modern regions v2. Select a country, then an independent region.
modern_regions.title: Independent regions and geographic area

modes.completion: Reference only; the started match reflects the selected mode.
modes.description: Select a map, size and mode. FFA has individual opponents; teams share victory and relationships. Humans versus nations groups the controllers. Ranked public matches have their own eligibility and rules.
modes.exercise: Inspect map preview and teams before starting.
modes.prerequisites: The main menu or a configurable lobby.
modes.title: Single-player, FFA, teams and humans versus nations

nukes.completion: An atom bomb in flight validates launch, not guaranteed damage or victory.
nukes.description: Inspect price, legal range, blast preview and friendly-fire risk before launch. Hydrogen bombs have different devastation rules; MIRV creates warheads automatically. SAM defenses and reloads affect results. Water targeting follows lobby rules.
nukes.exercise: Use a weapons training match; launch an atom bomb only at the intended target.
nukes.prerequisites: The selected weapon enabled, ready silo, gold and legal target.
nukes.title: Atom bomb, hydrogen bomb and MIRV

pause_speed.completion: Reference only; the game tick or replay cursor stops and resumes.
pause_speed.description: Single-player and replay controls permit pausing or changing speed. Public multiplayer is governed by server rules; local pause cannot stop another player's simulation. Pausing the tutorial guide alone does not pause play.
pause_speed.exercise: Use the current pause key or game controls, then resume.
pause_speed.prerequisites: A mode permitting the requested pause or speed action.
pause_speed.title: Pause and simulation speed

port.completion: An active completed port belongs to you.
port.description: Ports require owned coastal land. They support automatic trade and warship construction. An inland tile fails the coast condition; use the build menu to inspect a legal shore site.
port.exercise: Complete a port on a legal coast.
port.prerequisites: Ports enabled, coast and enough gold.
port.title: Port

profile.completion: Reference only; confirmed edits appear on your profile.
profile.description: Inspect your player profile and username settings. Verified names, avatars and account details depend on the existing account service. Free-form match names must satisfy the renderer's allowed characters.
profile.exercise: Open the profile and inspect the permitted edit controls.
profile.prerequisites: Profile service and sign-in for account edits.
profile.title: Profile and username

replay.completion: Reference only; playback follows the recorded sequence.
replay.description: Open the existing replay viewer for a recorded match. Scrub time, inspect territorial change and use playback speed controls. Record compatibility follows the build/version policy; a replay is not a live saved game.
replay.exercise: Review a major battle and compare the map before and after.
replay.title: Replay and review

resources.completion: Resource explanations are recorded as read, not as successful construction.
resources.description: Troops regenerate toward capacity; cities increase capacity. Territory and automatic trade support gold income. Starting gold, multipliers and infinite-resource settings change the rules and appear before play.
resources.exercise: Read troops, gold and growth; compare resource modifiers with the lobby settings.
resources.prerequisites: A spawned country and visible resource panel.
resources.title: Troops, gold, growth and economy rules

results.completion: Reference only; a new match starts with fresh game state.
results.description: The result screen reports the actual winner and game mode. Inspect territorial progress and replay options, then start another match. Single-player and training do not count as ranked public results.
results.exercise: Compare the victory objective with the result, then restart.
results.title: Victory, defeat and restart

retreat.completion: Reference only; check that the outgoing attack retreats or ends.
retreat.description: Use the outgoing-attack control to cancel or retreat. Withdrawal follows the existing combat rules; it does not instantly undo casualties or conquered land.
retreat.exercise: Inspect an ongoing attack and use its cancel control when the risk rises.
retreat.prerequisites: An outgoing attack that can be cancelled.
retreat.title: Cancel an attack and withdraw

rules.completion: Reference only; disabled actions are unavailable in both simulation and guide.
rules.description: Read the actual lobby rules: disabled units, alliance duration, resources, random spawn, time limit and public modifiers. Unavailable practices are filtered out; choose another training chapter with the feature enabled.
rules.exercise: Compare the unit menu with disabled-unit rules.
rules.title: Disabled units and special rules

sam.completion: Reference only; an actual interception shows defensive success.
sam.description: SAM launchers automatically intercept eligible airborne threats within their game-defined range and cooldown. SAM missiles are automatically generated; they are not manually built. Upgrades change available defense.
sam.exercise: Inspect defense range, construction and cooldown against a legal missile threat.
sam.prerequisites: SAM enabled, gold and a legal owned site.
sam.title: SAM launcher and air defense

save.completion: Reference only; the restored game continues from the stored tick.
save.description: Use supported single-player save controls to store a simulation snapshot. Course progress and lobby options are not a running-game save. Keep exports where available; storage can fail or a different build can reject a save.
save.exercise: Save during play, load it and compare territory, resources and AI state.
save.prerequisites: Single-player save controls, browser storage and the same supported build.
save.title: Save, load and continue a running game

silo.completion: A completed silo validates construction; launch readiness is checked separately.
silo.description: Nuclear launches need a completed ready silo, sufficient gold and a legal target. Construction and cooldown prevent launching even if you own a silo. Inspect its readiness indicator.
silo.exercise: Complete a silo and wait until it is ready.
silo.prerequisites: Silos enabled, affordable site and legal placement.
silo.title: Missile silo and reload

spawn.completion: The simulation confirms you have spawned and play has begun.
spawn.description: Choose land during the spawn phase. Random spawn chooses for you. Modern mode assigns your selected country's territory. Protection and lobby start delay follow the displayed rules.
spawn.exercise: Choose a legal start and wait until the spawn phase ends.
spawn.prerequisites: Join a match as a player; a spectator cannot spawn.
spawn.title: Starting position and protection

spectator.completion: Reference only; spectator state prevents player commands.
spectator.description: Join as a spectator when the lobby permits. Watch countries and relationships without spawning or sending combat commands. Observer name visibility may be restricted by the host.
spectator.exercise: Choose spectate and inspect the map without taking ownership.
spectator.prerequisites: A lobby or match permitting spectating.
spectator.title: Spectate

statistics.completion: Reference only; API records show the qualifying match.
statistics.description: Public profile statistics and rankings come from the existing API. Eligibility and match classification govern updates. Offline single-player and training are separate from ranked public games.
statistics.exercise: Inspect the match type beside a statistic or leaderboard.
statistics.prerequisites: Statistics service and qualifying recorded matches.
statistics.title: Statistics, leaderboards and ranked play

support.completion: Reference only; the confirmed donation changes both players' resources.
support.description: Eligible allies or teammates can receive support. Donations to humans may be disabled by lobby rules. Inspect the recipient and amount before sending; aid reduces your own reserve.
support.exercise: Open the donation controls and inspect amount and recipient.
support.prerequisites: An eligible recipient, resources and donations allowed by the rules.
support.title: Troop and gold donations

target.completion: Reference only; the target indicator appears.
target.description: Mark another player as a target to communicate priorities through the existing allied or team display. A target marker is advice; it is not an attack order.
target.exercise: Mark a target and inspect the shared target indicator.
target.prerequisites: A living player and target control.
target.title: Mark a target

trade.completion: Reference only; automatic trade arrival and income show the effect.
trade.description: Ports automatically send trade ships to eligible trading ports sharing accessible water. War, embargoes and missing routes can prevent trade. Trade ships are not manually built from the unit menu.
trade.exercise: Inspect trade ships and gold while toggling trade restrictions only when useful.
trade.prerequisites: Completed ports, a legal trading partner and connected water.
trade.title: Trade ships and sea income

transport.completion: The guide observes your transport afloat; successful landing is a separate outcome.
transport.description: Send troops from your coast across water to a legal destination. The existing route and enemy warships affect arrival. Transport is a troop commitment, not a directly purchased economic ship.
transport.exercise: Send a transport; inspect its route and cancel option.
transport.prerequisites: Transport enabled, owned shore, troops and a reachable water route.
transport.title: Transport ship and landing

upgrade.completion: Reference only; verify its level or auto-upgrade state changes.
upgrade.description: Eligible completed structures can be upgraded. Automatic upgrade repeats upgrades when the game permits and resources are available. Inspect the current price; stop automatic upgrading when the reserve is needed elsewhere.
upgrade.exercise: Open a structure's controls and inspect manual and automatic upgrade choices.
upgrade.prerequisites: An owned upgradeable structure and enough gold.
upgrade.title: Upgrade and automatic upgrade

warship.completion: Warship construction is practiced; selection and firing are reference topics.
warship.description: Build warships from eligible ports and move them over water. They fire shells automatically. Select one, box-select several or use select-all with your effective bindings; enemy warships can intercept transport.
warship.exercise: Complete a warship, then inspect single and multiple selection movement.
warship.prerequisites: Warships enabled, completed port, legal water destination and gold.
warship.title: Warships, movement and selection

education.guide_paused: Only the guide is paused. The match continues; use the game pause control in single-player to stop the simulation.

modern_hints.modern_air_produce: An unfinished, damaged or full base cannot produce. Wait for completion or repair; choose another base if capacity is full.
modern_hints.modern_army_train: Select an operational army base. Automatic formation uses existing army reserve first; available-personnel training must fit the mobilization cap. The pool choice and cost are shown before production.
modern_hints.modern_armybase: Choose a separate owned land tile. The price, time and base limit are in the build tooltip. Pause also pauses construction.
modern_hints.modern_box_select: Drag empty ground around a group. Shift-click a different group; Shift-clicking an already selected group does not add people.
modern_hints.modern_camera: Click the map before using keys. Text fields suppress map controls. On touch, use two fingers to pan and pinch to zoom.
modern_hints.modern_cursor: Select a living owned unit first. Choose owned land for a safe first army route; ships require connected water.
modern_hints.modern_navybase: Use your coastline where the port preview is valid. A completed port is one naval base; trade and major-port bonuses are not duplicated.
modern_hints.modern_queue: The second destination must be valid. The dashed route appears only after the core accepts it; wait for an actual completed move.

modern_steps.modern_ai_levels: Inspect the actual AI levels shown in country information. Levels are fixed by the seed and do not change the common starting population.
modern_steps.modern_air_intercept: Patrol near hostile aircraft with a fighter, or send a sortie near enabled enemy SAM. Wait for actual aircraft losses. Move the target inside the base radius and read the risk before ordering.
modern_steps.modern_air_launch: Choose Air {airKey} and click a fighter. Point within its base radius and right-click to patrol; a strike aircraft instead attacks an enemy target. Watch actual outbound aircraft; out-of-range targets show a reason.
modern_steps.modern_air_produce: Select the new operational air base, then produce a fighter or strike aircraft. Check the reserved cost, personnel and capacity. Wait for an actual new squadron at its base.
modern_steps.modern_air_return: Complete a short patrol, then watch Returning and Rearming. Wait for the actual return and resupply timer; no new sortie during rearming. Aircraft never capture land.
modern_steps.modern_airbase: Choose Air base in Build menu or Bases & production and right-click owned land. Check its price and press Confirm construction. Wait for completion; its capacity and health appear in the base information.
modern_steps.modern_army_move: Point to nearby owned land and right-click. The arrow becomes solid and stays while the army moves. Wait until it arrives. Against enemies, the army must actually fight and capture the ground. Touch: confirm the preview.
modern_steps.modern_army_train: In Bases & production choose your operational Army base and Train army. Cost and personnel are reserved once. Wait for the new unit to appear at the base; check the reserve and formation counts.
modern_steps.modern_armybase: Open Build menu or Bases & production. Choose Army base and right-click owned land. Check the price and press Confirm construction. Wait until its construction timer ends and the base is operational.
modern_steps.modern_box_select: Drag a box around one army group. Hold Shift and click another to add it. Selection counts must actually increase. If no second unit is visible, use {cameraKey} to find your starting groups.
modern_steps.modern_branches: Press Army {armyKey}, Navy {navyKey}, Air {airKey}, or each button below. The highlighted branch changes; this does not send units.
modern_steps.modern_camera: Use the arrow keys to move the map, then zoom with the wheel or {zoomInKey}/{zoomOutKey}. {cameraKey} returns to your units. Both a real camera move and zoom complete this step.
modern_steps.modern_climate_compare: Enable Climate overlay. Compare adapted and harsh unadapted army previews, then fight real ground exchanges in both climates. Both previews and actual losses in each climate are required.
modern_steps.modern_climate_train: Choose a new adaptation in Population and train it for {cost} gold and {seconds} game seconds. Capture alone does not train troops.
modern_steps.modern_cursor: With units selected, point to nearby owned land. Each unit shows a curved dotted arrow to this cursor target. Wait for the valid preview; a reason appears if the route is impossible. Touch: Target, then tap the land.
modern_steps.modern_mobilization: Fight a real army engagement and inspect the ledger's losses and replenishment. Producing a new branch uses existing manpower rather than creating people.
modern_steps.modern_navy_move: Choose Navy {navyKey}. In Bases & production produce a warship at an operational port and wait for its completion. Click the ship, point to nearby connected sea and right-click. Wait for actual arrival.
modern_steps.modern_navybase: Choose Naval base in Bases & production. Right-click a valid owned coastline, check its price and press Confirm construction. Wait for the Port to finish; it also keeps its normal trade role.
modern_steps.modern_nuclear_penalty: In this nuclear-only lesson, launch from a ready silo after reviewing the costs. Watch the firing faction's active economic penalty and the victim's separate damage.
modern_steps.modern_population: All independent factions start with {population} people. Open Population: civilian + available + army + navy + air = living population. Reserve troops are part of army personnel, not extra people.
modern_steps.modern_port_blockade: Produce and select a warship, choose Blockade near an enemy named port and confirm. The actual port state must list your blocking faction.
modern_steps.modern_port_capture: Use Army to capture the tile of a named enemy major port. Its core owner and capture count must change; aircraft alone cannot capture it.
modern_steps.modern_port_defend: Observe enemy warships blockading a developed port and reducing its income. Respond with your navy, end the blockade, and verify that the port income actually recovers.
modern_steps.modern_port_develop: Open an owned major port, pay for Development and wait for completion. Its level and actual income must rise together; blockade or damage may delay the income gain.
modern_steps.modern_queue: Right-click a nearby owned destination, then Shift-right-click another while moving. A dashed queued route follows the active solid route. Complete one real movement with an acknowledged queued order.
modern_steps.modern_regions: Inspect the selected independent region: its controller is unique. Shared parent country does not grant an alliance. Check the region's real area and any disclosed exception.
modern_steps.modern_select: Choose Army {armyKey}, then left-click your army icon. A selection ring and the selected count confirm selection. {selectKey} selects your visible army units. Touch: tap the icon.
modern_steps.modern_stop: Start another short move, then press {stopKey} or Stop while it is moving. Wait for the acknowledged idle state. {cancelKey} cancels preview or selection; it does not stop an active order.

modern_touch_steps.modern_air_intercept: Choose a fighter and patrol near enemy aircraft, or target near enabled enemy SAM inside your base radius. Observe real aircraft losses and the risk.
modern_touch_steps.modern_air_launch: Tap Air and a fighter. Use Target inside its base radius and Confirm order to patrol. A strike aircraft attacks an enemy target. Watch the actual outbound aircraft.
modern_touch_steps.modern_air_produce: Select an operational Air base and produce a fighter or strike aircraft. Wait for actual paid production; aircraft use personnel, capacity, gold and time.
modern_touch_steps.modern_air_return: After a short patrol, watch Returning and Rearming. Wait for actual return and resupply. Aircraft cannot capture land or launch again while rearming.
modern_touch_steps.modern_airbase: Choose Air base in Bases & production, tap owned land, check the price and Confirm construction. Wait for completion and inspect its capacity and health.
modern_touch_steps.modern_army_move: Use Target to preview nearby owned land and tap Confirm order. The solid route stays while your army actually moves. Wait for arrival; enemy land requires combat.
modern_touch_steps.modern_army_train: Choose an operational army base in Bases & production and tap Train army. Wait for the paid new unit to appear at that base.
modern_touch_steps.modern_armybase: In Bases & production choose Army base, tap valid owned land, check its price and Confirm construction. Wait until the base is operational.
modern_touch_steps.modern_box_select: Drag with one finger around one army group. Enable Add to selection, then tap another group. The actual selection count must increase.
modern_touch_steps.modern_branches: Tap Army, Navy and Air below in turn. The highlighted branch changes; selecting a branch does not launch units.
modern_touch_steps.modern_camera: Drag with two fingers to move the map, then pinch to zoom. Both a real pan and zoom complete this step.
modern_touch_steps.modern_cursor: With units selected, enable Target and tap or drag to nearby owned land. Each unit previews a curved arrow. Wait for a valid route; an impossible target explains why.
modern_touch_steps.modern_navy_move: Choose Navy, then produce a Warship at an operational port. Tap the finished ship, use Target on connected water and Confirm order. Wait for its actual arrival.
modern_touch_steps.modern_navybase: Choose Naval base in Bases & production, tap a valid owned shore and Confirm construction. Wait for the Port to finish; its trade role remains.
modern_touch_steps.modern_queue: Start a move. Enable Queue command, then Target and another valid owned destination. Confirm the preview. Wait for an acknowledged queued route and a completed real move.
modern_touch_steps.modern_select: Tap Army, then tap one of your army icons. The selection ring and count confirm selection. Select visible units selects your visible army.
modern_touch_steps.modern_stop: Start a short move, then tap Stop while it is moving. Wait for actual idle state. Cancel clears placement or selection; Stop halts an active order.

education.no_results: No matching feature. Try a shorter search or another chapter.

practice.attack_nations: The nearby tribes are blocked by nations. Conquer an accessible opponent while keeping a reserve, or skip and retry on a different training map. Completion requires a real conquest.
practice.attack_wilderness: Expand into adjacent land with a small attack. This exercise completes only after your territory actually increases. Sending an attack alone is not enough; watch your troop reserve.
practice.capture_tribes: Conquer a nearby gray tribe. Compare its troops with yours, keep a reserve, and wait until its remaining territory becomes yours. Earning gold alone does not complete this exercise.

education.practice_confirmed: The game's state confirms this action succeeded.
education.practice_hint: An exercise completes after the game confirms the result. Wait for captured land or completed construction. Check the build menu for cost and placement, or skip this exercise and return later.
education.read_confirmed: Explanation read. This is separate from practical completion.
education.reference_intro: The basic practice is short. Repeat a topic when needed, or search every public feature here. Reading a reference does not mark a practical exercise as completed. Prices and availability come from the current game's build menu.
education.storage_error: Course progress could not be saved. Browser storage may be full or blocked. Existing saved progress is retained; keep this game open and retry later.
education.touch_hint: Drag to pan and pinch to zoom. Tap territory to open the radial menu. Preview the action and cost, then choose it; dismiss the menu to cancel. Build on owned land and reach a coast for boats.
education.training_rules: Prepared training: 1,200 coastal tiles, 10,000 initial displayed troops (subject to the troop cap), 10M gold, one weak practice tribe and one cooperative nation. These training advantages are separate from competitive AI rules.
education.training_spawn: Your practice country starts on a prepared coast. Find its highlighted territory, then expand into nearby land. Starting-position selection is covered in the searchable feature guide.

modern_v2.ai_all_enhanced: All modern AI use decision profiles; individual low/medium/high levels follow the shown weights.
modern_v2.ai_plan: Active operations {operations} · next decision in {seconds}s · target {target}
modern_v2.ai_weights_hint: Weights assign low/medium/high AI independently by seed. Defaults 1:1:1. No difficulty adds people, income or damage. At least one weight must be positive.

area_exception_reason.administrative: This grouping preserves administrative boundaries and connected territory but falls outside the usual area range.
area_exception_reason.component_area: The area of this disconnected landmass cannot be divided entirely into regions within the usual range.
area_exception_reason.isolated: This island or detached territory remains independent rather than joining distant regions merely to reach the target area.
area_exception_reason.parent_area: The country's total area cannot be divided entirely into regions within the usual range.

modern_v2.climate_legend: Yellow arid · green tropical · blue temperate · purple continental · white polar. Historical climate distribution; terrain and temporary weather are separate.
modern_v2.command_sent: Order sent; watch the unit's acknowledged state.
modern_v2.common_start: Common start: {population} people · {gold} gold · {army} army personnel. These are game values, independent of actual national population.
modern_v2.confirm_preview: Right-click to order; Shift-right-click adds a queued destination.
modern_v2.fair: All humans and AI start with the chosen common population, money and manpower rules. Land pixels do not increase population capacity or income. Individual AI levels change decisions without resource or damage bonuses. Each region commands its own forces; shared parent country grants no automatic alliance. No gray tribes. Every objective uses the displayed time limit as a fallback.
modern_v2.fill_empty_slots: Fill empty invitation slots with AI at start
modern_v2.ground_preview: Estimated single-tile ground exchange: attacker loss {attacker}, defender loss {defender}, defender climate {defenderClimate}%, relative climate modifier {ratio}%. Fronts and reinforcements may change the outcome.
modern_v2.input_hint: Move cursor to preview · Right-click move/attack · Shift queues
modern_v2.landlocked: No owned major port. Industry and land trade still support your economy.
modern_v2.ledger: Civilian {civilian} · available {available} · army {army} · navy {navy} · air {air} · dead {dead}. Military personnel are included in total population, not additional people.
modern_v2.no_units: No eligible units selected. Choose a unit marker or the unit list.
modern_v2.nuclear_launch_notice: On actual launch: {seconds} game seconds of income -{economy}%, replenishment -{replenishment}%, diplomatic trust -{trust}. Interception does not remove responsibility. One MIRV launch counts once; repeated launches stack up to the caps.
modern_v2.nuclear_status: Nuclear responsibility: income −{economy}%, replenishment −{replenishment}%; last penalty expires in {seconds} game seconds. One MIRV launch counts once.
modern_v2.paused_commands: The game is paused. Your preview is kept. Resume the game, then execute the command.
modern_v2.preview: ETA ≈ {seconds}s · air radius {range} tiles · risk {risk} · climate efficiency {efficiency}%
modern_v2.preview_unavailable: Route check failed. Wait for the worker to respond and try again.
modern_v2.production_hint: Production uses the shared manpower ledger. Aircraft need an owned airbase; warships need a usable port.
modern_v2.production_sent: Production order sent; personnel, gold and base capacity are checked by the simulation.
modern_v2.queue_preview: This is a Shift queued order. Air routes and ETA start from the base after the previous sortie returns and rearms; actual waiting time is additional. Routes and targets are checked again when the order executes.

reason.airbase_unavailable: Airbase is destroyed, captured or unavailable. Use an owned operating base.
reason.aircraft_already_sortied: Aircraft are already on a mission. Wait for return or cancel.
reason.aircraft_rearming: Aircraft are resupplying. Wait for the displayed cooldown.
reason.army_requires_land_transport: Army needs passable land. Use a transport landing order to cross sea.
reason.armybase_unavailable: Build an army base on owned land and wait for completion.
reason.base_already_exists: A base is already at this tile. Choose another owned location.
reason.base_capacity: Base capacity is full, including reserved production. Select another operational base.
reason.base_damaged_or_repairing: Repair the base or wait for its current repair to finish.
reason.base_limit: Your base limit is reached. Use or repair an existing base.
reason.base_repair_unavailable: Choose an owned damaged base that is not already repairing.
reason.base_requires_owned_land: Army and air bases need your own valid land.
reason.base_under_construction: Wait for this base or production to finish. Pause also stops its timer.
reason.command_queue_full: Order queue is full. Cancel or wait for a mission to finish.
reason.escort_target_lost: The escorted owned transport is gone or its mission has ended. Select an active owned transport again.
reason.faction_defeated: This faction has been defeated. Start a new scenario or review the replay.
reason.fighter_cannot_ground_strike: Fighters intercept aircraft and contest airspace. Select a strike squadron for ground targets.
reason.force_limit: The faction formation limit is reached. Use existing units.
reason.friendly_or_protected_target: Target is friendly or under protection. Move on your own land or wait for protection to end.
reason.front_changed: The front changed. Review a new target.
reason.insufficient_army_reserve: Wait for reserve troops to accumulate, or train available personnel within the mobilization cap.
reason.insufficient_gold: Not enough gold. Restore income and retry.
reason.insufficient_manpower: Check available personnel and the common mobilization cap. For army formations, use trained reserve troops; for new air/naval personnel, release room within the cap.
reason.insufficient_upkeep: Not enough gold for aircraft upkeep. Restore income before more sorties.
reason.mobilization_limit: Mobilization limit reached. Retrain existing reserves.
reason.navy_requires_navigable_water: Navy needs connected navigable water or a valid coast.
reason.navybase_disabled: Ports are disabled by this game’s rules.
reason.navybase_no_valid_site: No legal owned coastline nearby. Choose another coast away from existing structures.
reason.no_owned_land_path: No owned land route within the search budget. Move closer or use transport.
reason.no_personnel: This unit has no personnel. Replace losses before ordering it.
reason.no_reachable_landing: No reachable landing shore near the target.
reason.no_transport_departure: No legal departure coast for transport.
reason.no_water_path: No water route. Choose a target in the connected sea.
reason.not_base_owner: Choose a base you currently own.
reason.not_force_owner: You can command only your own forces.
reason.outside_air_range: Target is beyond the base's operating radius. Build a nearer base.
reason.path_terrain_changed: Terrain changed along the route. Review the route again.
reason.port_unavailable: Own and restore an eligible major port before developing it.
reason.retreat_requested: Retreat requested; committed troops return through the normal retreat rules.
reason.strike_cannot_intercept: Strike aircraft attack ground and ports. Select fighters for interception.
reason.target_changed: Target ownership changed; the mission was reconsidered.
reason.training_unavailable: Check the current training, adaptation and funds. Finish the active training before starting another.
reason.unknown: The order is unavailable in this state.
reason.waiting: Unit is waiting for new orders.
reason.warship_disabled_or_count: Warships are disabled or this production count is invalid. Use a naval-enabled scenario.
reason.warship_requires_port: Build or select an operational owned port with navigable water.
reason.warship_unavailable: Warship is missing, captured or inactive. Build an owned ship at a port.
reason.water_component_disconnected: That sea is disconnected from the fleet's water region.
reason.wrong_branch_mission: This mission belongs to a different branch or aircraft kind.

modern_v2.scope: {count} independent factions on a {width}×{height} world. Geographic area and population rules are separate from screen tiles.
modern_v2.select_units: Left-click or drag to select; move the cursor to preview, right-click to order.
modern_v2.slot_roles: Invitation-slot AI and unselected world rulers are labeled separately. Each faction has one controller; humans reserve a faction before starting.
modern_v2.split_policy: Countries above 1.2M km² are grouped along administrative boundaries, aiming for 0.8–1.2M km² per independent region. Smaller countries remain intact. Exceptions are disclosed; shared nationality gives no automatic alliance.
modern_v2.transport_preview: The blue route is the transport and landing leg. Enemy warships can intercept it.
